Team,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the Sparrow mini-summit yesterday. Attached is the cleaned attendee export and my initial pass at routing. High-level:

- Total registrants: 642, Attended: 287
- High-intent (product-fit + demo requested during Q&A): 14 accounts, 37 contacts
- Warm (engaged, downloaded materials): 68 contacts

Attachments: Sparrow_Attendee_List_06122027.csv, Sparrow_MQL_Prioritization_Sheet.xlsx
Replay link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2bSparrowReplay (also in the attached txt)

1) P1 — Demo ASAP (within 48 hours):
   - Sparrow Maritime (acct: Sparrow Maritime Inc) — 3 contacts flagged; asked for pricing during Q&A. Recommend Marcus take (deal: SP-2027-0612).
   - NorthWave Cyber — demo asked; account is EU-based but legal ok with hosted API. Recommend Ben take.
2) P2 — Warm outreach (2 business day cadence): 10 accounts. Assign to SDR pool with personalized clip and replay.
3) P3 — Nurture via drip and content (replay + 1-pager) for remainder.

Requests:
- Marcus/Ben: can you claim P1 accounts by EOD today and reply with owner names so I can update HubSpot?
- Tessa: please publish the replay in the marketing drip and add the 1-pager asset to the email template; attach the tracking param used below.

HubSpot note: I'll attach the related company record links in the sheet; primary HubSpot company id for Sparrow Maritime is 98765.

I'll push a cleaned CSV to the shared drive and flag the 14 high-intent rows. Let me know if you want any follow-up copy edits before I send the first wave.

Thanks,
Irene

--

Redwood Inference
